name: Douglas County, KS
findings: Douglas County has 530 nonprofit organizations. 259 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 216 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Douglas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 24 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
